description: This file defines the TransactionRollback class, a method operation for handling transaction rollback in the Apache OFBiz MiniLang framework. It includes logic for performing a rollback given certain context conditions and manages external method calls related to transaction management.

classes.name: TransactionRollback
classes.description: A class implementing a MiniLang method operation to perform a transaction rollback, either conditionally based on a context flag or unconditionally.

classes.name: TransactionRollback.TransactionRollbackFactory
classes.description: A factory class to create instances of TransactionRollback from XML elements.

methods.name: TransactionRollback
methods.description: Constructor initializing the operation with configuration from an XML element.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the rollback operation within the given method context.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the transaction rollback element.
